description: This file defines a Python class 'LangchainProcessor' that integrates Langchain runnables with Pipecat's frame pipeline, handling LLM message frames, processing them through a Langchain chain, and streaming responses.

classes.name: LangchainProcessor
classes.description: Processor that integrates Langchain runnables with Pipecat's frame pipeline, handling LLM message frames and streaming responses.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LangchainProcessor with a chain and optional transcript key.

methods.name: process_frame
